title: Update on New Tourism Development in Jurong Lake District
what_it_is: Update on New Tourism Development in Jurong Lake District

sections.label: Ukraine war and tourism site
sections.summary: The war in Ukraine and global economic slowdown created uncertainty, but STB remains confident in the tourism site's potential near the new Science Centre and Jurong Lake Gardens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The war in Ukraine, coupled with the overall slowdown in global economy, created an uncertain economic environment during that period, especially for the tourism sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: However, Singapore Tourism Board (STB) remains confident in the tourism potential of the site as it is adjacent to the new Science Centre and Jurong Lake Gardens.

sections.label: Jurong Lake District development plans
sections.summary: URA launched a tender for the Jurong Lake District master development site, with plans to develop it into the largest mixed-use business district outside the city centre over 10 to 15 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Two weeks ago, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) launched a tender for the master development site at the Jurong Lake District and, indeed, the launch of the master development sale site will kickstart the next phase of development for the Jurong Lake District.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And I want to assure the Member and the residents staying in the area that over the next 10 to 15 years, the plan is to develop the Jurong Lake District into the largest mixed use business district outside of the city centre, in line with the blueprint.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And this is in line with Singapore's strategic objective for decentralisation, so that the residents staying in that part of Singapore will have access to very attractive job opportunities within close proximity.

sections.label: Tourism site and Jurong Lake attractions
sections.summary: The tourism site will be developed for attraction and leisure use with ancillary hotel and retail uses, next to Jurong Lake Gardens, with collaboration opportunities with the new Science Centre.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, while the master development sale site will be developed mainly for office and residential uses with complementary amenities, such as retail shops, to serve the needs of the residents as well as the workers, the tourism site eventually, when launched and completed, will be developed primarily for attraction and leisure use – like the Member talked about earlier in his supplementary question – with ancillary hotel and retail uses that will serve both the residents and the visitors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure him that our STB colleagues are looking at the RFP and the tourism site sits next to the 90-hectare Jurong Lake Garden, which is our third national garden and the location capitalised on the beautiful views and the direct 300-metre long water frontage for Jurong Lake.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And there will also be, like I said in my answer to the Parliamentary Question (PQ) answer, tremendous opportunities for collaboration with the nearby new Science Centre.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, with plans for more than 10 kilometres of active lakeside seamlessly linked by a promenade and also boardwalk around Jurong Lake, I want to assure the Member that a string of attractions will be created around the lake, all set amidst a very lovely, immersive greenery experience for the visitors, workers as well as his residents.
